text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so, I invited Flash-san this year♪ 
Things were totally chaotic last year, so 
I wanted someone around to support us.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let's go sightseeing together 
during our breaks~♪ 
We're at a resort beach, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I plan to consider leisure activities only 
after all event-related schedules have 
been finalized.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will do my utmost to be of assistance to 
everyone. 
I look forward to working with you all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've got to do my best too! 
I'll prepare some pickled plums to help 
ward off the summer heat.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Times like this call for travel feng shui! 
First, to boost our travel luck, 
let's place orange items in the southeast 
of the bedroom or toward our destination☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez, feng shui again? Forget travel luck, 
we need to brainstorm concrete PR ideas 
for work—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone is so motivated...♪ 
I really want to give them all the support 
I can. Right, Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As their senior, let us watch over 
them properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The festival venue is a beautiful resort 
beach far away. 
Preparations on-site begin a few days 
before the event opens—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're here~~~~!! 
Our ultimate good-luck 
auspicious-direction trip~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, this is work, not a 
vacation~~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a work trip! The energy of the 
compass directions is limitless. 
Traveling to a great location means taking 
fortune into your own hands!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For the visitors and for us... right? 
Let's make this an amazing place and 
spread tons of good luck around!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... a great festival, you 
mean. 
Just don't forget that work comes first, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know! 
Tarumae, you're always so serious~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First, let us inspect the entire venue. On 
the day of the event, visitors 
are expected to move freely between the 
beach and the nearby resort facilities.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The locations of each booth and the call 
sheets are roughly decided, 
but finer details will be adjusted during 
rehearsals, as I understand it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's quite spacious. 
We'll have to make sure we don't get lost 
when moving around...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Shara-la~n☆ Over here is the pool~♪ 
Around here is where the merch and food 
booths will be set up!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haha, there's an AR photo spot for 
commemorative pictures too. 
Shall we take a quick detour and snap a 
photo?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely!! 
...Actually, let's do it later.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huhhh, why not!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to be properly prepared before 
taking photos like that. 
Fix my hair and makeup, get some props 
ready, make sure it'll actually go 
viral...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aww, come on~... 
It's fine as just a candid personal photo! 
Let's take it now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In any case, if you could decide 
quickly... 
We are scheduled to move to the next 
location in 1 minute and 42 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“Eh-ahr”? “Photo spot”...? 
A photo is just a photo, right...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall I give it a try first? 
Now, which button was the shutter 
again...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, the effects will not display without 
the dedicated camera app, 
so there is little point in taking it... 
Ah, under one minute remaining...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's huge... Is that the live stage? 
The very one Falco-san stood on last 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the speakers are facing west...!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, in feng shui, the basic rule is 
“things that make sound go in the east.” 
The direction you place items separates 
the zones of “stillness” and “motion”...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, Rickey, enough about feng shui! 
Excuse us, it's nothing, really...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'm totally serious, you know? 
When you spend a long time somewhere, 
balancing the yin and yang qi makes it way 
more comfortable☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Look though, at that position the noise 
will carry all the way to the break area. 
Guests who want to relax won't be able to 
settle down...!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... separating the areas properly does 
seem pretty important, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's actively improve the 
environment!☆ 
Let's move that partition over there, 
and..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat... really!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! It was laid out like this last year 
too, right? 
We shouldn't mess with it unnecessarily, 
it'll just give the staff more work!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, don't you want to 
give it our absolute best? 
All to create an extra-large happy 
festival!☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, what if we take a risk and it 
fails? 
We really should stick to what's worked 
before—!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Oje, not again...! Er, let's first 
compare the pros and cons of both 
opinions...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine~! 
Just calm down for a second. There we go, 
deep breath☆"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Haah! 
...Inhale... exhale..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this call for 'toi, toi, toi', 
right? 
Don't worry, it'll all work out~."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... thank you. 
You're right, a simple difference in 
opinion is nothing to panic over... 
*giggle*."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it just feels like dejavu. 
We used to go through things like this 
too, back then..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you mean that? 
A lot happened back in the day, didn't 
it~? Even for Falco and the others at the 
start."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... well, this is no time to 
reminisce. 
Right now, we need to properly support 
those three."
